analyzed_vuln.description: Heap OOB read is caused by ff_vc1_mc_1mv passing unclamped chroma source pointers to VC1 chroma MC (put_no_rnd_vc1_chroma_mc8_c). The function clips uvsrc_x/uvsrc_y for edge handling decisions, but in the non-edge-emulation path it directly computes srcU/srcV and calls chroma interpolation that reads src[a+1] and src[stride+a+1] up to a=7, requiring a 9-pixel-wide valid source row. For boundary macroblocks this requirement is not enforced, so the chroma MC reads 1 byte past the allocated plane buffer.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger via VC1 P-macroblock 1MV decode path (vc1_decode_p_mb -> ff_vc1_mc_1mv) with motion vectors / MB position placing chroma reference at the right/bottom edge while edge emulation is not entered (boundary check in ff_vc1_mc_1mv evaluates false). Then ff_vc1_mc_1mv invokes put_no_rnd_vc1_chroma_mc8_c with h=8 and fractional chroma offsets, and the bilinear kernel accesses src[8]/src[stride+8], causing a 1-byte read past the chroma buffer end.
